SIR Form Submission Campaign Faces Slow Pace in Faridabad

The SIR (Systematic Voter's List Revision) campaign in Faridabad is experiencing a slow pace, with only 45% of forms submitted by the deadline of July 14. Officials are urging timely submission, with concerns that Booth Level Officers (BLOs) may be holding onto submitted forms. Citizens can check the status of their SIR form submission via phone.
